name: +1 Dig Every Jump 👀
desc:
🌟 +1 Dig Every Jump 🌟
Jump to dig, dig to conquer!

In this addictive digging game, every jump carves out blocks — and every layer is a new challenge.
Gain Wins by reaching the bottom, and re-gather strength and dig back down even faster with each win!

🏆 How to play:

🦘 Jump to break ground!

🧱 Use your Dig Strength to blast through dirt, clay, and stone, etc.

🎁 Earn Wins to boost your dig strength per jump and unlock rewards!

🛍️ Keep winning and upgrading yourself to become the ultimate digger.

Can you become the best digger in the world?

👍 Don’t forget to Like the game, Join the group, Follow the owner, to help the whole community unlock free rewards!
